TASK task_0002 — Write ONE file: C:\kamlesh\test\games\zombie3\js\audio.js

CONTEXT
- Browser game, runs from file:// (no server). NO fetch, NO audio files, NO external URLs, NO ES modules (`module`/`export`/`import` forbidden). Classic script.
- Pure Web Audio API synthesis. The game calls this module for every sound. It must never throw, even before the first user gesture (before that, just queue/drop silently and no-op).
- The host page loads it as `<script src="js/audio.js"></script>` and uses the global `Z3Audio`.

REQUIRED PUBLIC API (exact names)
- `Z3Audio.init()` -> AudioContext + buses created lazily (idempotent, safe to call repeatedly). Buses: master (GainNode) -> destination, plus `sfx` bus and `ambient` bus both into master. Add a mild DynamicsCompressor on master.
- `Z3Audio.resume()` -> resumes a suspended context (call from a user-gesture handler)
- `Z3Audio.isReady()` -> boolean
- `Z3Audio.setEnabled(bool)` / `Z3Audio.isEnabled()`
- `Z3Audio.setMasterVolume(v)` / `Z3Audio.setSfxVolume(v)` / `Z3Audio.setAmbientVolume(v)` (0..1, clamped)
- `Z3Audio.play(name, opts)` where opts = `{ volume=1, rate=1, pan=0, distance=null, delay=0 }`:
  - `rate` scales playback rate/pitch, `pan` is stereo pan (-1..1), `distance` (0..1, 0 = close) applies extra distance rolloff/filtering (use a lowpass whose frequency drops with distance, plus gain rolloff), `delay` schedules with `ctx.currentTime + delay`.
  - Unknown names must be ignored without throwing.
- `Z3Audio.startAmbient()` / `Z3Audio.stopAmbient()` — looping generative ambient bed: wind gusts (filtered noise with slowly modulated bandpass), distant city rumble/drone (low oscillators), occasional far-away zombie moan, occasional distant metal creak. Must be fully randomised over time so it never loops audibly. Uses the ambient bus.
- `Z3Audio.setThreat(x)` (0..1) — raises tension: louder/faster low-frequency drone, more frequent distant moans and a heartbeat pulse that starts around x>0.5. Must be smooth (ramp over ~1s, no clicks).
- `Z3Audio.setOccluded(bool)` optional but if you add it, keep it a no-op-safe simple lowpass toggle on a filtered bus for indoor audio muffling.
- `Z3Audio.stopAll()` — stop all one-shots/ambient immediately.

REQUIRED SOUND NAMES (all synthesized, must sound distinct and punchy)
Guns (short transient + body + tail; use noise bursts through filtering, fast exponential envelopes, a low "thump" sine sweep, and a short convolver/feedback-delay tail for outdoor slap; do NOT sound like beeps):
`pistol`, `shotgun` (deep, wide, long tail), `rifle` (bright crack, tight), `smg` (lighter, faster), `dryFire`, `shellDrop`
Reload / handling: `magOut`, `magIn`, `boltRack`, `safetyClick`
Impacts: `impactFlesh` (wet thud + squelch), `impactConcrete` (gritty crack + rubble), `impactMetal` (metallic ping + ring), `impactWood` (dull knock), `impactDirt`, `headshot` (wet burst + crunch, distinct crunch layer), `whizz` (bullet passing near: short filtered noise sweep in stereo)
Zombies: `zombieGrowl`, `zombieScream` (aggro screech), `zombieAttack` (guttural lunge), `zombieDeath` (gurgle + wet collapse), `zombieHurt`
Player: `playerHurt`, `playerDeath`, `gruntLight`, `gruntHeavy` (sprint exhale, short breath noise), `footstepConcrete`, `footstepDirt`, `footstepMetal`, `footstepGrass`, `jump`, `land`, `lowHealthHeartbeat`
World/UI: `waveStart` (siren-ish rising two-tone + distant horde), `waveClear` (short relief sting of 3 quiet tones + distant birds), `pickupAmmo` (metal clink x2), `pickupHealth` (bandage/paper rustle + soft tone), `explosion` (deep boom + debris), `lockPick`/`uiClick` (soft quiet UI click), `uiHover`.

QUALITY BAR
- Use `ctx.createBufferSource` with short pre-generated noise buffers (reuse one shared noise buffer generated at init, 2 seconds, white and pink variants) rather than creating buffers per shot.
- Layered sounds: e.g. gunshot = click transient + filtered noise burst + body noise + low thump + tail. Zombie growl = two detuned sawtooth/sine oscillators through a lowpassed waveshaper with slow vibrato + throat noise.
- Randomise every shot slightly (pitch +-3%, gain +-10%, filter +-5%, tail length) so repeat shots never sound identical.
- No clicks/pops: always ramp gains with `setTargetAtTime`/`exponentialRampToValueAtTime` from a small non-zero value, and stop oscillators after their envelope.
- Hard cap: max ~24 simultaneous one-shot voices; if exceeded, drop the quietest/oldest new request to avoid audio blowout.
- Keep the file under ~750 lines, 2-space indent, short commented helper functions, English comments.

VERIFY BEFORE REPORTING (required)
Run `node --check C:\kamlesh\test\games\zombie3\js\audio.js` and paste the output. Then grep your own file to prove every required sound name string appears (e.g. `Select-String -Path ... -Pattern "'shotgun'"`). Do NOT create or modify any other file.

Report: status, absolute path, line count, full list of implemented sound names, and the verification command output.
I'll start by exploring the workspace to understand conventions, then write the audio module.
